analysis_resolution: Full decoded pixel resolution for every view; no pre-analysis resize
split_protocol: Whole collage and left/right midpoint crops are analyzed independently; cropped JPEG recompression is a separate experiment
timing_scope: JPEG encode, decode, absolute difference and channel averaging; excludes source loading, statistics, plotting and export
format_note: Non-JPEG inputs measure AVIF/WebP/PNG-to-JPEG differences, not a verified original JPEG history
